howItWorks.subtitle: Booking a medical appointment has never been so simple. Done in under a minute.

step1.title: Search for a specialist
step1.description: Enter the desired specialty or doctor's name, then select your city or wilaya to get a list of certified practitioners near you.

step2.title: Choose your slot
step2.description: Check real-time availability, and book a specific time slot or join the clinic's live queue.

step3.title: Confirmation & tracking
step3.description: Receive confirmation of your appointment and track its status directly from your patient portal.

doctorSection.subtitle: Mawidi transforms your daily management — fewer phone calls, zero unexpected absences, and better-informed patients.

dashboard.title: Smart Dashboard
dashboard.description: View all your appointments for the day, manage your schedule, and track your consultation stats in real time.

queue.title: Waiting Room Management
queue.description: Manage your patients by queue mode or appointment mode, and track the status of each consultation live.

reminders.title: Automated SMS & Email Reminders
reminders.description: Reduce no-shows by 60% with automated reminders sent 24h and 2h before each consultation.

footer.description: The first online medical appointment booking platform for Algeria. Reliable, secure, and available 24/7.
